This directory contains third-party libraries vendored locally to remove CDN dependency.

- xterm.js v5.5.0 (MIT) — https://github.com/xtermjs/xterm.js
  Copyright (c) 2017-present, The xterm.js authors

- @xterm/addon-unicode11 v0.8.0 (MIT) — https://github.com/xtermjs/xterm.js
  Copyright (c) 2017-present, The xterm.js authors

- @xterm/addon-fit v0.10.0 (MIT)
- @xterm/addon-search v0.15.0 (MIT)

- lucide-static v0.469.0 (ISC) — https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide
  Copyright (c) 2024, Lucide Contributors

- highlight.js v11.11.1 (BSD-3-Clause) — https://github.com/highlightjs/highlight.js
  Copyright (c) 2006, Ivan Sagalaev
  common 번들(36개 언어). 테마 CSS는 포함하지 않는다 — 색은 app.css의 스킨 토큰으로
  직접 정의해야 5개 테마(특히 라이트인 notepad)를 따라가기 때문.

Each library retains its original license; full texts available at the source repos.
